description: ERR-BASE: DBEngine.Errors on a fresh engine; after OpenDatabase of an absent file (construction failure before association); after a successful open; after failure A (OpenRecordset on a missing table); after success S (snapshot on T); after failure B (Execute 'SELEC'). Then A on a second Database in the same Workspace, and B on a Database in a second Workspace. A second DBEngine created in the same process is read before and after its own failure, and the first engine's Errors is read after it.
retentionNote: Designed r-dao-1-err-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
